2607.21573.title: Beyond Sufficiency: Time Series Explanation with Counterfactual Necessity
2607.21573.paper_summary: Faithful explanations of time-series classifiers should identify subsequences that are not only sufficient to preserve a black-box model's prediction, but also necessary for maintaining it. However, existing sufficiency-oriented methods can assign high importance to spurious subsequences that support the prediction without being essential to the model's decision. We introduce \textbf{TimePNS}, a necessity-aware framework for time-series explanation. Inspired by Pearl's counterfactual notion of necessity, TimePNS assesses whether a temporal factor is necessary by intervening on it and measuring whether the original prediction is disrupted. The framework adopts a two-stage design. Stage I learns an identifiable causal generative process together with a sufficiency-oriented explanation mask. Stage II performs counterfactual interventions on temporal factors to derive necessity signals, which supervise a temporal gate that refines the initial explanation by suppressing non-essential components and emphasizing counterfactually necessary ones. Experiments on synthetic and real-world time-series benchmarks show that TimePNS more accurately identifies decision-critical subsequences and consistently improves sufficiency-necessity trade-offs over strong baselines.
2607.21573.paper_summary_zh: 忠實的時間序列分類器解釋應該能夠識別出不僅足以保持黑箱模型預測的子序列，還必須對於維持該預測是必要的。<lb/>然而，現有的以充分性為導向的方法可能會對支持預測但對模型決策並非必要的虛假子序列賦予高重要性。<lb/>我們引入了\textbf{TimePNS}，一個關注必要性的時間序列解釋框架。<lb/>受到Pearl的反事實必要性概念的啟發，TimePNS通過對時間因素進行干預並測量原始預測是否受到干擾來評估該因素是否是必要的。<lb/>該框架採用兩階段設計。<lb/>第一階段學習可識別的因果生成過程以及一個以充分性為導向的解釋掩碼。<lb/>第二階段對時間因素進行反事實干預，以推導必要性信號，這些信號監督一個時間閘，通過抑制非必要組件並強調反事實必要的組件來精煉初始解釋。<lb/>在合成和現實世界的時間序列基準測試中的實驗顯示，TimePNS更準確地識別出決策關鍵的子序列，並持續改善強基準上的充分性-必要性權衡。
